question: On 23 December 2021, Maharashtra passed which of the following Criminal Law Acts to approve death penalty for heinous offences against women and children?
solution:
The correct answer is __**shakti**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shakti Criminal Laws (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill**, 2020 was passed in Maharashtra to allow the death penalty for rape and other heinous crimes against women and children. 
 
• Over **the past decade, the Indian Parliament has introduced amendments to the IPC**, specifically enhancing penalties for severe rape cases.
 
• Notable **amendments include the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act of 2013, permitting the death penalty **for rape cases involving fatal brutality or rendering victims in a prolonged vegetative state.
 
• Additionally, the same Act prescribed the death penalty for repeat offenders
